$comment: Customer-facing templates. Used by the mock composer, as the fallback when the compose call fails or the reply guard rejects a composed reply, and for fixed system messages. Placeholders: {firstName} (first word of the customer's name), {orderNumber}, {itemNames} ('A', 'A and B', 'A, B and C'), {amount} (e.g. $1,299.00), {customerReason} (customer-safe reasons for the deny rules, from policy.config.json customerReasons, joined with a single space, placeholders inside them filled from policy config), {note} (reviewer note).
greeting: Hi {firstName}, thanks for verifying your order {orderNumber}. Select the item or items this is about, then tell me what went wrong.
clarify: Thanks, {firstName}. To help with your {itemNames}, could you tell me a bit more about what went wrong? For example, did it arrive damaged, is it faulty, is it the wrong item, or have you changed your mind?
approved: Hi {firstName}, I'm sorry about the trouble with your {itemNames}. Good news: your refund of {amount} has been approved. It will go back to your original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.
denied: Hi {firstName}, thank you for explaining what happened with your {itemNames}. I'm sorry, but I can't offer a refund for this request. {customerReason}
escalated: Hi {firstName}, thanks for the details about your {itemNames}. I've passed your request to a member of our support team, who will review it and reply within one business day.
humanApproved: Update from our support team: your refund of {amount} has been approved. It will go back to your original payment method within 5 to 10 business days. Note from the reviewer: {note}
humanDenied: Update from our support team: after reviewing your request, we're unable to offer a refund. Note from the reviewer: {note}
